Publish.LongDescription:
# ExtraLandscapingTools This mod aims to add features and improve existing ones for the game's landscaping tool.
## Features ### Brushes parameter You can now change the brush and rotate it. ### Ore, Oil, Underground water and fertile land tools You can now add resources to your map using this tool. ### Custom brush You can now add custom brushes to your game by dropping image files into `ModsData/ExtraLandscapingTools/CustomBrushes` in your Cities Skylines II data folder. Check the wiki on the Github page of the mod for more details. if you need help, ping me on discord @triton_supreme. ### Resource regeneration Choose how ore, oil, fertile land, fish and groundwater behave on your map: keep them infinite, or make them regenerate gradually every in-game day, configurable per resource.
## Feature roadmap * ✔️ Refill used resources * ✔️ Custom brush * ✔️ Brush angle * ✔️ Ore, Oil, Underground water and fertile land tools * ✔️ Brushes parameter * ✔️ Resource regeneration modes
